Title: Golden Bough Platter
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind scalloped oval platter built up over three separate pours, layer on layer, so the colour has real depth to it — crimson and rose bleeding through amber, gold and buttery yellow, with fine dark veining running underneath the surface like grain in wood. Finished with a pair of solid gold-toned branch handles.

The most involved piece in the collection: three rounds of pouring and curing before the handles went on.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Blue Hibiscus Coasters — Set of 4
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind set of four resin coasters cast as five-petal hibiscus blooms. Each petal runs from a frosted white edge through soft periwinkle into deep sapphire, with a vivid lime-and-teal flare down the centre. The dark heart of each flower throws out a starburst of golden stamens.

Title: Moss Agate Bowl
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind deeply fluted bowl, ribbed all the way round like a scallop shell, with a softly ruffled rim. The finish is cloudy sea-green drifting over warm cream — mottled and speckled the way moss agate is, darker green gathering in the folds and clearing to a pale gold pool in the centre. Light coming through the ribs picks out every ridge.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!
